title: Assurance Gaps in an Integrated Safety and Cybersecurity Case for an AI-Based Perception Component in Highly Automated Driving
description:
Supplementary material for two SAFECOMP 2026 papers. Builds the single GSN argument that ISO 26262, ISO 21448, ISO/SAE 21434 and ISO/PAS 8800 jointly imply for an AI-based perception component in highly automated driving, and reports the decision points and findings the combination exposes.

Includes the argument as machine-readable YAML, the five-step integration code, a generated traceability index from every claim to its clause or paper passage, an interactive argument view, and a notebook that follows one runtime anomaly clause by clause until no clause assigns it to a concern.
